description: Card-funded Loan liability ownership. A borrowed Loan financed on a tracked Credit Card (fundingSource=creditCard + linkedCreditCardId, as the unified wizard creates an installment purchase) is the card's liability exactly like a card-linked EMI: it locks its outstanding principal against the card while no represented purchase carries it (Cases B/C), and it is never also counted as a borrowed Loan in Net Worth. flowfi-web computes each case with its credit-utilization / loan-balance-sheet engines; Finance_App builds the same state through its real repositories + Riverpod providers. Byte-identical copy in both repos. Loan: no interest, 8 monthly installments of 5,000. Installment payments are recorded on the schedule only (no Account movement), exactly like card-emi-ownership-fixture.json. Purchases are dated 'now' so they fall in the live current cycle on both platforms.

cases.name: 1 Case B: a 40,000 card-funded purchase locks 40,000 of an 80,000 limit and is counted once
2 Case B after two 5,000 installments: exactly 10,000 of credit recovers
3 Case A: the linked 40,000 card purchase owns the exposure - never 40,000 + 40,000
4 Case A after two installments: the plan payments do not re-lock or double count
5 Case C: linked purchase deleted - the Loan owns the exposure again
6 Completed: all 8 installments paid - the full limit is released
7 Closed after two installments: closing releases the lock, like a closed card-linked EMI
